subject: Plexis Health — billing route, vendor onboarding & PO vs card
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Grant <lydia.grant@plexishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + procurement signals from today's call (PO vs card + marketplace)

Hi Lydia — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can map the right commercial path: 

- Summary from the call: Plexis is excited about the latency/cost profile we showed for the summarization pipeline. Procurement will own vendor onboarding, and FinOps will decide billing route.
- Key procurement signals you shared: if the annual contract or first-year spend is > $50k, procurement prefers a PO. For smaller pilots they may allow corporate card, but AP needs vendor validation first.

A few asks so we can prep the right paperwork and timeline:
1) Can you confirm the AP contact and preferred vendor onboarding packet? Is there a vendor portal link?
2) If Plexis proceeds with a PO, do you require Net30 or Net60? Any specific tax or W9 requirements?
3) You mentioned interest in buying via AWS Marketplace (if available). Would marketplace purchase be preferred over PO/card, and does that materially speed procurement at Plexis?

If it helps, I attached a short vendor onboarding checklist and a terms summary we usually send to procurement so they can triage requirements quickly. Proposed next steps from our side: 1) we’ll send the vendor onboarding packet, 2) draft a short MOU for the pilot (non-binding) to be converted to a PO if you move forward.

Would you be able to introduce me to the AP/procurement lead on the thread? Happy to keep the initial ask light — just vendor verification and standard W-9/tax docs to get things started.

Thanks —

Mina Haddad
Senior Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf, redwood-terms-summary.pdf
From: Lydia Grant <lydia.grant@plexishealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@plexishealth.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up + procurement signals from today's call (PO vs card + marketplace)

Thanks Mina — great summary. Copying procurement so they have context. Short answers below: 

- AP contact: procurement@plexishealth.com (you have them on cc). They use a standard vendor portal but also accept emailed packets for smaller vendors.
- PO vs card: for pilots under $20k we typically let the product team use a corporate card. For anything expected to exceed $50k in the first 12 months, procurement will require a PO and SOW. Between $20k–$50k is case-by-case.
- Net terms: default is Net30; Net60 requires VP finance approval and usually slows things down.
- Marketplace: if Redwood is in AWS Marketplace with consolidated billing enabled, procurement is open to that and it often shortens the vendor verification steps. However, they still need a vendor record even for marketplace purchases.

Procurement note: please send the onboarding packet (vendor packet + W-9). We will start an initial vendor record and let you know if any additional docs are needed.

Best,

Lydia Grant
Head of Product | Plexis Health
lydia.grant@plexishealth.com
